sn1.71:1.1: Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn1.71:2.1: Kiṃsu chetvā sukhaṃ seti || kiṃsu chetvā na socati || kissassa ekadhammassa || vadhaṃ rocesi Gotamā ti || ||
sn1.71:3.1: Kodhaṃ chetvā sukhaṃ seti || kodhaṃ chetvā na socāti || kodhassa vīsamūlassa || madhuraggassa devate || vadham ariyā pasaṃsanti || taṃ hi chetvā na socatīti || ||
